House.text: Introduction and first reading, referred to Legacy Finance

bill_text.text_with_changes:
A bill for an act relating to arts and cultural heritage; appropriating money for Walker West Music Academy.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. [+APPROPRIATION; WALKER WEST MUSIC ACADEMY. +]

[+$300,000 in fiscal year 2026 is appropriated from the arts and cultural heritage fund to the commissioner of administration for a grant to the Walker West Music Academy for a series of 12 free concerts, youth and adult music education, professional development for music educators, and community choir programs. +]
bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to arts and cultural heritage; appropriating money for Walker West Music Academy.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. APPROPRIATION; WALKER WEST MUSIC ACADEMY.

$300,000 in fiscal year 2026 is appropriated from the arts and cultural heritage fund to the commissioner of administration for a grant to the Walker West Music Academy for a series of 12 free concerts, youth and adult music education, professional development for music educators, and community choir programs.
additions: $300,000 in fiscal year 2026 is appropriated from the arts and cultural heritage fund to the commissioner of administration for a grant to the Walker West Music Academy for a series of 12 free concerts, youth and adult music education, professional development for music educators, and community choir programs.
